subject: MAP: POC environment dependencies (VPC peering, IP allowlists, SSO/SAML, secrets/KMS)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Grady <tom.grady@acme.com>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: POC environment dependencies (VPC peering, IP allowlists, SSO/SAML, secrets/KMS)

Hi Tom / Lydia

Thanks again for today's discovery call. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the POC focusing on environment setup. Below are the milestone items we agreed to track, proposed owners, and target dates. Please review and confirm owners/target dates so we can lock the schedule.

POC milestone: Environment setup dependencies
- VPC peering (required): Redwood and Acme to establish peering between Redwood POC VPC and Acme dev VPC. Target: 2026-01-26. Owner: Acme network team (please confirm contact).
- IP allowlists / firewall rules: Acme to add Redwood egress IP ranges to allowlist for API and KV endpoints. Target: 2026-01-20. Owner: Acme security / infra.
- SSO / SAML SSO integration: Configure Okta SAML for the POC admin console and SSO login. Target: 2026-01-22. Owner: Acme IAM + Redwood support (we will provide metadata).
- Secrets / KMS (customer-managed): Determine whether Acme will provide a customer-managed KMS or use Redwood-managed keys for the POC. If customer KMS, Acme to provide key ARN and access policy. Target: 2026-01-24. Owner: Acme security + Redwood infra (Nikhil copied).

Dependencies:
- Network diagram and subnet ranges (Acme)
- Okta metadata and test user (Acme)
- KMS policy guidance (Redwood to provide template)

Attachments: map-draft-v1.pdf (MAP PDF), network-requirements.xlsx (please fill with subnet/IP ranges).

Next steps:
1) Confirm internal owners for each line item by EOD 2026-01-14.
2) If owners need a technical sync, let's schedule a 30-min network/infra call next week propose Tue/Wed.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment dependencies (VPC peering, IP allowlists, SSO/SAML, secrets/KMS)

Thanks Marissa good recap and appreciate the MAP. Quick notes from our side:
- VPC peering owner: Lydia Park (cc'd) will lead this and coordinate with our cloud network team. She expects to have peering tickets opened by 2026-01-14. We will confirm CIDR overlap and any NAT requirements.
- IP allowlists: Security (we) will add Redwood's egress ranges; can you send the official list and endpoints?
- SSO/SAML: We use Okta. Lydia will share metadata and a test account.
- KMS: We prefer customer-managed keys for production, but for the POC we can start with Redwood-managed keys to speed things up; if we move to customer-managed KMS we will need the access policy template you mentioned.

We can do a short tech sync Tue 1/20 10:00 EST works for Lydia, otherwise Wed 1/21 11:00 EST.

Tom
Head of Product Operations | Acme Corp
tom.grady@acme.com

Thanks Tom great, confirming owners noted. Lydia appreciate you stepping in for peering. Nikhil, looping you in to confirm the KMS options and to provide the egress IP ranges for the allowlist. Can you also share the KMS policy template and whether Redwood can accept a customer KMS for a short-lived POC?

Nikhil specific asks for this thread:
- Confirm whether Redwood supports using a customer-managed KMS for POC (short-term key usage) and any onboarding steps.
- Provide Redwood egress IP ranges and the API hostnames we need whitelisted.
- Any additional network ports or CIDR considerations for peering (we'll share our network diagram once Lydia fills the sheet).

If you prefer, we can include a short 30-min technical call with Lydia and her network engineer. Tom/Lydia does Tue 1/20 10:00 EST still work?

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tom Grady <tom.grady@acme.com>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment dependencies (VPC peering, IP allowlists, SSO/SAML, secrets/KMS)

Hi all quick technical answers: 
- Customer-managed KMS: We can support customer-managed AWS KMS for the POC. For a short-term POC we recommend granting a dedicated key with a cross-account key policy; I'll attach a policy template and a short checklist. For speed, starting with Redwood-managed keys is fine and won't block testing.
- Egress IP ranges: Redwood POC egress ranges (US-west)  54.10.32.0/24, 54.11.44.0/24. API endpoints: api.redwood-inference.com, kv.redwood-inference.com. Please add those to your allowlist.
- Ports/CIDR: Standard HTTPS (443) only for API. For VPC peering we do not require specific ports beyond HTTPS; ensure no overlapping CIDRs. If you plan to call internal debug ports, let me know and we'll advise.

I'll upload the KMS policy template and a one-page checklist to the shared doc. If you want, I can join the tech sync on Tue 1/20 10:00 EST.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior SRE | Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.com
